result: Reviewed human UniProtKB entries, release 2026_03, read through rest.uniprot.org. TPH1 (P17752): oxidises L-tryptophan to 5-hydroxy-L-tryptophan in the rate-determining step of serotonin biosynthesis. SLC6A4 (P31645): modulates mucosal serotonin in the gastrointestinal tract through uptake and clearance in enterocytes, is required for enteric neurogenesis and gastrointestinal reflexes (by similarity), and regulates blood serotonin through rapid high-affinity uptake from plasma into platelets for storage in dense granules. HTR3A (P46098): serotonin-gated cation channel; detected in cortex, amygdala, hippocampus, small and large intestine, spleen and tonsil monocytes, uterus, prostate, ovary and placenta. HTR4 (Q13639): Gs-coupled receptor activating adenylate cyclase; expressed in ileum, brain and cardiac atria. HTR2B (P41595): Gq-coupled, detected in liver, kidney, heart, pulmonary artery and intestine; required for cardiac development, osteoblast function and bone density, and proliferation of intestinal interstitial cells of Cajal (by similarity). HTR2A (P28223): Gq-coupled; detected in brain cortex and blood platelets; role in intestinal smooth muscle contraction and possibly arterial vasoconstriction (by similarity). HTR1A (P08908): Gi/Go-coupled; detected in lymph nodes, thymus, spleen and activated T cells. AANAT (Q16613): N-acetylates serotonin to N-acetylserotonin, controlling the night-day rhythm of melatonin production in the pineal gland; ASMT (P46597): methylates N-acetylserotonin to melatonin.
